import seaborn as sns

data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
data['date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['date'])

# Create a pivot table for total sales by date and product
sales_pivot = data.pivot_table(values='total', index='date', columns='product', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=sales_pivot, linewidth=2.5)
plt.title('Daily Sales Trend by Product', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Product', fontsize=10, title_fontsize='12')
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
